figures_found: Unity developer pay in Belarus $950-$5,500/mo depending on experience; entry roles from $500-1,000/mo; Unity devs with 3+ years offered from $3,000/mo
notes: The best Unity-specific Belarusian source found. A local recruitment agency quoting the bands it actually places against. Anchors every grade in the table. Note on net pay: employees of High-Tech Park (HTP) resident companies pay 9% flat income tax instead of the standard 13%, so the same gross goes further at HTP employers — all figures here are gross and unadjusted
